title: Delay in Roll-out of Distance-based Charging in Next-generation ERP System
what_it_is: Delay in Roll-out of Distance-based Charging in Next-generation ERP System

sections.label: Next-generation ERP and GNSS
sections.summary: LTA chose GNSS for the next-generation ERP because the current system, in place since 1998, is reaching the end of its operational life.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The key reason for switching to the next-generation ERP, or nexgen ERP, is that the current system, which has been in place since 1998, is reaching the end of its operational life.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: After studying several options, LTA concluded that the Global Navigation Satellite System, or GNSS, was the most suitable technology to use for nexgen ERP.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: It can also potentially be used for distance-based charging.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: There is no specific contract cost attributable to this feature, as it is part of the system design in the contract.

sections.label: Distance-based pricing timing
sections.summary: Distance-based pricing is several years away.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: As announced earlier, such distance-based pricing is several years away.

sections.label: Rollout schedule and duration
sections.summary: The rollout will begin around the second half of 2021 and take about 18 months.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, we are going to roll this out around second half of 2021 and it will take about 18 months.

sections.label: Distance-based charging and Parking.SG
sections.summary: Decisions on revenue neutrality and other taxes are premature, distance-based charging is several years away, and Parking.SG already enables coupon-less car park charging.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, with regard to his questions, about whether it will be revenue neutral and what about the other taxes and so on.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I think it is premature, we will have to study all these different approaches first in order to come to a decision.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said and I think we have consistently said – any form of distance-based charging is several years away.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regards to coupon-less car park charging, Parking.SG is already able to do this.
